question: How to evaluate the frozen detector implementation under controlled CPU/RAM limits without claiming UAV-processor equivalence?
scope: Five selected configurations, four profiles, three development recordings, one technical trial: 60 pairs; code design and later integration only

research.recommended: Container-enforced resource sensitivity in a declared Linux ARM64 VM
alternatives: Target-calibrated virtual approximation requiring hardware evidence

evidence_validation.caveat: Chen abstract verifies constrained embedded-like evaluation and bounded logging; indexed-only host/Pi4 details are not gate evidence

clarifications: Accepted ingress availability instead of pre-send timestamp
Required functional parity for selected five, broader 66-model coverage optional
Numeric tolerance cannot change threshold crossings/states/events

acceptance_checks: G2 full pipeline paths and functional parity
G3 independent source, clock and queue evidence

execution_hold: Superseded by explicit user instruction to prepare and start selected pilot. Measurement gate still required before measured trials.
